about.title: About Me
about.content:
Hi, I'm Jenny, a certified Kangoo Jump trainer. I'm passionate about combining fitness with fun, and I've found Kangoo Jumps to be the perfect way to do that. These low-impact, high-energy workouts are great for improving cardio, strength, and flexibility while keeping things exciting!

I love helping people of all fitness levels feel confident and motivated. Whether you're new to fitness or an experienced athlete, my classes are designed to energize and challenge you in a fun way.

Join me for a Kangoo Jump session and experience a workout that's as enjoyable as it is effective!

welcomeText: Welcome to my Kangoo Jump classes, where fun, fitness, and results come together to help you feel stronger and more energized!
startPrompt: Click the button below to get started.
gallerySubtitle: Explore photos from my Kangoo Jump classes. Each picture captures the fun and energy we share together!

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Kangoo Jump is a fun and high-intensity workout that uses special rebound shoes designed to reduce impact and increase calorie burn.
faq.q2: How can I book a Kangoo Jumps class?
faq.a2: You can book a class by visiting our schedule page or contacting us directly through the contact form.
faq.q3: What are the benefits of Kangoo Jumps?
faq.a3: Kangoo Jumps helps improve cardiovascular fitness, strengthens muscles, and enhances coordination while minimizing joint stress.
faq.q4: Do I need to bring my own shoes?
faq.a4: We provide Kangoo Jumps shoes for all participants, but feel free to bring your own if you prefer.

about.lead: Hi, I'm Jenny — a pharmacist by training and a certified Kangoo Jumps instructor in Burgas. I believe movement is the best care for your health when it brings a smile and a real surge of energy.

highlights.title: Pharmacist with a health-first approach
highlights.text: My pharmacy background shapes how I coach — with careful attention to posture, breathing, and safe, sustainable load.

highlights.title: Certified Kangoo Jumps instructor
highlights.text: I design varied, rhythmic routines with clear technique cues that keep motivation high and make every class feel fresh.

highlights.title: Personal attention & supportive community
highlights.text: I look out for everyone in the studio and build a welcoming atmosphere where you feel comfortable, confident, and recharged.

workoutMetrics.title: The Workout in Numbers
workoutMetrics.subtitle: What to expect from a single Kangoo Jumps session in the studio.

items.label: Less joint impact
items.desc: The rebound spring system absorbs landing shock on every jump.

items.label: Calories burned
items.desc: High-energy rhythmic cardio that engages your entire body.

items.label: Session length
items.desc: Warm-up, rhythmic choreography, strength work, and cool-down stretch.

items.label: Boots provided
items.desc: Sanitized Kangoo Jumps boots in EU sizes 36–46 waiting for you.

firstJump.title: Your First Jump
firstJump.subtitle: Never tried Kangoo Jumps before? Here is how your first class goes from booking to cool-down.

steps.title: Pick a slot and boot size
steps.text: Choose a convenient time from the schedule and your boot size (S 36–38, M 39–41, L 42–44, XL 44–46) online with no account needed.

steps.title: Arrive 10 minutes early
steps.text: Give yourself a few relaxed minutes to put on the boots and get a feel for the bounce before the music starts.

steps.title: Fit check with Jenny
steps.text: Jenny checks the buckles, helps you find your balance, and shows you the basic stance — most beginners feel steady within 3 minutes.

steps.title: 50 minutes of music and energy
steps.text: Move at your own pace. Every routine is beginner-friendly and easy to adapt so you feel confident right from class one.

bringItems.title: Tall athletic socks
bringItems.note: Must reach above the ankle to protect your skin from the boot cuff.

bringItems.title: Comfortable workout clothes
bringItems.note: Leggings or shorts and a breathable top.

bringItems.title: Water bottle (at least 500 ml)
bringItems.note: Stay hydrated during the short water breaks.

bringItems.title: Small towel
bringItems.note: Your Kangoo Jumps boots will be waiting ready in the studio.
